description: Change existing keyframes of a property (Animation > Keyframe Interpolation, Keyframe Velocity, Keyframe Assistant, the Graph Editor buttons and the keyframe context menu): interpolation presets such as Easy Ease, Easy Ease In/Out, Auto Bezier, Continuous Bezier, Linear and Toggle Hold Keyframe; incoming and outgoing interpolation and ease (speed and influence of the Bezier handles); Rove Across Time; motion path tangents; keyframe colour label; the value of every chosen keyframe (Edit Value); and Time-Reverse Keyframes. keys.times adds a keyframe where none exists, holding the value there, as the keyframe navigator or the Pen tool on a motion path does

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

easeIn.description: Incoming temporal ease (Keyframe Velocity dialog, Graph Editor handle): speed and influence for every dimension

speed.description: Speed in the property's units per second. Default 0

easeOut.description: Outgoing temporal ease: speed and influence for every dimension

speed.description: Speed in the property's units per second. Default 0

keys.description: Which keyframes of the property: those matching any of indexes, the from/to time range, times or selected. Omit for all of them

from.description: Keyframes at or after this time (seconds)

selected.description: The keyframes selected in the Timeline panel

to.description: Keyframes at or before this time (seconds)

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

preset.description: linear, bezier, auto_bezier, continuous_bezier, hold (both sides), toggle_hold (outgoing Hold, or back to Auto Bezier), easy_ease, easy_ease_in, easy_ease_out

property.description: A property: a shortcut (anchor_point, position, scale, rotation, opacity, x_rotation, y_rotation, orientation, source_text, time_remap, audio_levels) or a path of match names or display names from the layer, e.g. ["ADBE Effect Parade", "Gaussian Blur", "Blurriness"]

roving.description: Rove Across Time (spatial properties; the first and last keyframes never rove)

spatialAutoBezier.description: Auto Bezier on the motion path (spatial properties only)

spatialContinuous.description: Continuous Bezier on the motion path (spatial properties only)

spatialTangents.description: Motion path direction handles, relative to the keyframe, in pixels (spatial properties only)

in.description: Incoming tangent [x, y] or [x, y, z]

out.description: Outgoing tangent [x, y] or [x, y, z]

timeReverse.description: Time-Reverse Keyframes: mirror the chosen keyframes in time within their span (done before the other changes)

value.description: New value for every chosen keyframe: a number, an array of numbers, text or true/false

name: edit_keyframes
title: Edit Keyframes
